title: Sr. HR Executive
description:
1. A. Recruitment & Manpower Planning

* Coordinate recruitment for Sales Executives, Team Leaders, Service Advisors, Technicians, Mechanics, Parts Executives, Customer Relationship Executives (CRE), and other dealership positions.
* Conduct walk-in interviews, schedule interviews, screen resumes, and coordinate with department heads.
* Monitor manpower requirements, vacancies, replacement hiring, and joining targets.
* Coordinate offer letters, appointment letters, joining formalities, and employee onboarding.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and recruitment MIS reports.

B. Attendance & Payroll Coordination

* Monitor daily attendance, late arrivals, absenteeism, overtime, and leave records.
* Ensure employees regularly update attendance through the company HRMS.
* Coordinate attendance regularization and monthly attendance closing within the prescribed deadline.
* Verify attendance and payroll inputs, including incentives, leave without pay (LOP), and approved deductions.
* Coordinate with the Accounts / Payroll team to ensure timely salary processing.

C. Employee Records & HR Documentation

* Maintain employee personal files, KYC documents, appointment letters, and other employment records.
* Ensure timely issuance of ID cards, uniforms, and other employee-related materials.
* Maintain employee databases, department-wise manpower reports, and HR documentation.
* Process employee confirmation, transfer, promotion, resignation, and full-and-final settlement documentation.

D. Employee Engagement & Retention

* Organize birthday celebrations, employee recognition programs, festival celebrations, and other engagement activities.
* Support employee grievance handling and maintain positive employee relations.
* Conduct exit interviews and identify reasons for employee attrition.
* Coordinate induction programs and employee welfare initiatives.
* Promote employee participation in company engagement surveys and internal activities.

E. Statutory Compliance & HR Policies

* Coordinate applicable PF, ESI, professional tax, labour welfare, and other statutory compliance activities.
* Maintain statutory records and coordinate with the relevant departments or consultants for timely submissions.
* Ensure compliance with company HR policies, applicable labour laws, and dealership procedures.
* Support internal HR audits and ensure timely closure of identified compliance gaps.

F. Training & Performance Management

* Coordinate employee induction, product training, technical training, and departmental training programs.
* Monitor probation periods, confirmation dates, and employee performance reviews.
* Support implementation of KRAs, KPIs, and performance appraisal processes.
* Coordinate with department heads to identify employee training and development needs.

G. Employee Discipline & Uniform Compliance

* Monitor employee discipline, grooming standards, punctuality, and company uniform compliance.
* Communicate HR policies, circulars, and instructions to employees.
* Coordinate show-cause notices, counselling, and disciplinary documentation in consultation with the HR Manager.
* Conduct periodic branch visits to verify HR process compliance.

H. HR MIS & Reporting

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly HR MIS reports.
* Submit reports on headcount, vacancies, recruitment status, attrition, attendance, absenteeism, and employee costs.
* Track recruitment turnaround time, joining ratios, employee retention, and pending HR activities.
* Maintain accurate HR data in the company's HRMS and Excel trackers.
* Report critical manpower and employee-related issues to the reporting manager.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

title: Placement Officer
description:
Job description:

Job Summary

We are seeking a proactive and result-oriented Placement Officer to build strong industry relationships, create employment opportunities for students, and manage the end-to-end campus placement process. The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication, networking, and organizational skills, along with the ability to guide students toward successful career outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

* Collaborate with academic departments to understand students' skills and employer requirements.
* Collect employer feedback and continuously improve placement strategies.
* Achieve placement targets and ensure high student employment rates.
* Prepare periodic placement reports, analytics, and performance metrics for management.
* Stay updated with industry hiring trends, emerging job roles, and labor market requirements.
* Support internship and apprenticeship programs in collaboration with industry partners.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, Education, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in placement, recruitment, HR, talent acquisition, or career services.
* Experience working with educational institutions is an added advantage.

Required Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong networking and relationship-building abilities.
* Knowledge of recruitment processes and campus hiring.
* Career counseling and student mentoring skills.
* Event planning and coordination.
* Presentation and public speaking skills.
* Strong organizational and time management abilities.
* Problem-solving and negotiation skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
* Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) or CRM tools is an advantage.

Key Competencies

* Leadership
* Relationship Management
* Employer Engagement
* Student Counseling
* Team Collaboration
* Strategic Thinking
* Attention to Detail
* Target-Oriented Approach
* Adaptability
* Professionalism

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of companies onboarded.
* Number of campus drives conducted.
* Student placement percentage.
* Internship conversion rate.
* Employer satisfaction score.
* Student satisfaction score.
* Number of industry collaborations established.
* Placement target achievement.

Preferred Industry Exposure

* Higher Education Institutions
* Universities

* Management Institutes

* Vocational Training Institutes

* Competitive salary package
* Performance-based incentives
* Professional development opportunities
* Industry networking exposure
* Paid leave and statutory benefits
* Career growth opportunities

title: Seasonal MyHR Live Support Sr. Advisor, WWAS TA C Sourcing
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

This is a contract role  
  
The My HR Live Support (MHLS) team is currently seeking to hire an MHLS Sr. Advisor to support our Tier 2 Specialty Operation. The MHLS Tier 2 Specialty Team primarily provides customer service to Amazon employees through phone, chat, ticketing, and cases related to payroll, disability, policies, among others. This role will act as a point of contact for the team, offering immediate assistance on complex issues and handling challenging contacts. The Sr. Advisors provide case consultations and overall resolution and support for all types of leaves of absence and disability life events to our Amazon employees. They are highly skilled in answering questions, obtaining the right information from SOPs and knowledge centers, providing direct support through different live and written channels, understanding the employee’s situation, applying appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances; and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. The Sr. Advisor will also escalate trends to management to address any training or quality gaps identified.  
  
The ideal candidate will possess exceptional communication and organizational skills, a keen attention to detail, the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment, strong relationship-building and influencing abilities, robust analytical and critical thinking skills, and a customer service focus that aligns with Amazon's global standards.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Respond to inquiries about disability and leave events, time-off, payments, and work-related situations available to employees.
* Inbound and Outbound phone, chat and case support through the Specialized Support Queues.
* Serve as a point of contact for employees to provide holistic case management services, including medical documentation review to adjudicate compliance with corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon.
* Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs.
* Address and respond to sensitive situations in benefit of employee experience and attempt to de-escalate complex cases.
* Manage own workload effectively to meet productivity goals and escalate when significant changes or gaps in assigned workload arise.
* Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event.
* Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication and documentation occurs, even when information is limited.
* Use good judgement and rationale to balance process adherence with employee’s needs to analyze and decide on disability, leave and benefits requests.
* Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp-back plan for employees returning to the workplace.
* Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to starting a leave or returning back to work.
* Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing.
* Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy.
* Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation.
* Consult, coordinate and partner with our third-party administrator, local HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits team members and other support units as appropriate.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
* Minimum of 1 year experience in customer service or Human Resource management or Case management or Leave & Disability management role

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of case management experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
* Experience identifying and resolving complex issues
* Experience working with and protecting confidential and sensitive HR information
* Ability to build strong relationships and influence others while working in a cross functional environment

title: TA and People Partner
description:
**Role purpose:**

Prevalent AI is a fast-scaling, AI-first security organization with teams operating across multiple geographies. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Talent Acquisition and People Partner to drive recruitment delivery and people partnering while contributing to the wider effectiveness of our People function.

This role carries primary responsibility for managing end-to-end Talent Acquisition independently, partnering with hiring managers and business leaders to understand resource requirements, develop effective sourcing strategies and deliver high-quality hiring outcomes across technical and business functions. The role requires someone who can take ownership of multiple recruitment priorities, provide strong candidate experience, and adapt to recruitment approaches to meet changing business needs. The talent acquisition will be for the wider organization, which predominately will be technical roles but also provide an opportunity to drive successful execution on global Sales and Client Solutions positions.

The role also demands contribution to the broader People activities, including onboarding, people partnering, employee engagement, and internal communications for the talent spread across the globe. This provides an opportunity to contribute beyond recruitment and develop a broader understanding of the People function.

We are looking for a proactive, commercially aware and collaborative professional with high level of independent thinking and ownership who combines strong recruitment execution with sound stakeholder management, attention to detail and an interest in supporting the wider global employee experience.

**Key accountabilities:**

1. **Talent Acquisition and Recruitment Delivery**

* Own and deliver the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle for roles across the globe, covering technical, product, AI, cybersecurity, business, Sales and other functions as required.

* Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements, clarify essential skills and experience, agree with recruitment priorities, and establish realistic hiring timelines.

* Develop and execute effective sourcing strategies using direct headhunting, job portals, professional networks, referrals, direct sourcing and other relevant channels to build qualified candidate pipelines.

* Work closely with agency headhunters, recruitment partners and EOR (Employer on Record) providers based on the needs to fill specific roles in specific geographies.

* Be a passionate advocate for the business and our growth opportunities with candidates who may not currently be looking for a role.

* Conduct initial candidate assessments, evaluate role suitability, communicate opportunities effectively and present relevant candidates to hiring managers.

* Coordinate and drive interview processes, maintain momentum across hiring stages and ensure timely feedback, clear communication and a positive candidate experience.

* Manage candidate engagement and experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle, including offer discussions, compensation alignment, negotiations, offer approvals, documentation and pre-joining follow-up.

* Monitor recruitment progress, identify bottlenecks and take corrective action when pipelines are weak; requirements change or hiring timelines are at risk.

* Maintain accurate recruitment records and pipeline updates in BambooHR and other relevant recruitment tools, providing visibility into progress, risks, and outstanding actions.

* Track and report recruitment metrics, including pipeline status, time-to-fill, conversion rates and hiring outcomes, using insights to improve recruitment effectiveness.

* Support employer branding and represent Prevalent AI professionally in candidate interactions, communicating the company's culture, values, opportunities, and employee proposition.

* Manage relationships with recruitment vendors and external sourcing partners where required and support the effective use of recruitment platforms and tools.

* Contribute to workforce and resource planning discussions by providing recruitment pipeline insights, market feedback and hiring feasibility assessments.

  

2. **People Operations and Onboarding Support**

* Work closely with the newly onboard team members to ensure that they embrace their new roles and close any learning gaps without delays.

* Co-ordinate with other team members within and outside HR to ensure onboarding completion on time.

* Actively engage the new team members during their initial days in Prevalent AI – irrespective of the locations they join to ensure that the messaging and onboarding followed are uniform across the organization and a memorable experience for the new joiner.

* Maintain accurate employee records in BambooHR, including new starter information, role changes, contract updates, and offboarding records.

* Support the administration of core People processes, including reviews, contract renewals, leave management and policy acknowledgements.

* Assist with resource management administration by maintaining team allocation trackers and highlighting changes or potential conflicts for review.

* Work as a single point of contact for all employee related queries for the team members onboarded in other global locations, ensuring the same first-class experience regardless of where on the globe the new team member joins.

* Work collaboratively with the People and Administration teams to ensure employee-related processes are completed accurately and efficiently.

  

3. **Events and Cultural Initiatives**

* Support the planning and execution of employee engagement initiatives; , annual all-hands meetings, Rewards & Recognition events, and team activities

* Work with colleagues across the People team to deliver well-organized, inclusive and engaging employee experiences.

* Contribute ideas and practical support to initiatives that strengthen collaboration, reinforce company values, and improve employee engagement.

  

4. **Managing Employee Performance and Professional Growth**

* Create a supportive environment for team members to learn, perform, grow, and get rewarded.

* Maintain regular employee connects with team members across the globe

* Actively engage with team members and understand early warning signals on attrition

* Supporting our bi-annual performance process with timely documentation and admin support.
* Preparing reports, follow-ups, and statistics on performance review and goal-setting processes.

  

5. **Internal Communications and Collaboration**

* Draft, coordinate and publish People-related communications based on briefs and guidance from the People Director or relevant team members.

* Ensure communications are clear, accurate, professional and consistent with Prevalent AI's Authentic, Focused and Inquisitive values.

* Coordinate communication inputs for recruitment, onboarding, L&D, employee engagement and cultural initiatives, ensuring timely distribution.

* Collaborate proactively across the People team, share updates, follow through on commitments and provide operational support where priorities require it.

  

**Skills and Experience:**

To be successful in this role, you will be a proactive and accountable professional who can independently manage recruitment delivery while contributing to the wider priorities of the People function.

  

* Strong end-to-end Talent Acquisition experience: Demonstrated ability to independently manage recruitment from requirement intake and sourcing through assessment, interview coordination, offer management and joining.

* Technical recruitment capability: Experience headhunting and recruiting for technical roles, ideally within IT, software, SaaS, product, AI or cybersecurity environments, with the ability to understand technical requirements and identify relevant talent.

* Stakeholder partnership: Strong ability to work with hiring managers and business leaders, clarify requirements, manage expectations, provide market insights, and maintain alignment throughout the recruitment process.

* Sourcing and problem-solving: Ability to develop targeted sourcing strategies, build relevant candidate pipelines and adapt approaches when hiring requirements are challenging or progress is slower than expected.

* Recruitment ownership and delivery: Strong organizational and follow-through skills, with the ability to manage multiple requisitions, competing deadlines and changing priorities while maintaining quality and candidate engagement.

* Data and process orientation: Attention to detail in maintaining recruitment records, tracking progress, monitoring hiring metrics, and using data to identify delays and improvement opportunities.

* Communication and relationship management: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to engage professionally with candidates, hiring managers, vendors and internal stakeholders.

* Candidate experience and employer representation: A professional, candidate-focused approach, with the ability to communicate company values, culture and opportunities effectively.

* Collaboration within the people function: Willingness to contribute to, People administration, Learning & Development coordination, Rewards and events as part of a broader People team.

* Interest in broader People Operations: Extensive prior experience across all HR operational areas is not essential; however, a genuine interest in learning and contributing to these activities is important.

* Systems and digital tools: Proficiency in Microsoft 365, particularly Excel and Word. Experience with BambooHR or similar HRIS/ATS is advantageous, alongside an openness to using AI tools such as Claude and Copilot to improve productivity and work quality.

* Personal effectiveness: A proactive, dependable, and collaborative working style, with sound judgement, discretion when handling confidential information and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  

**Education:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline. A qualification in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, Psychology or a related field is preferred.

title: HR Executive
description:
Job Summary

The HR Executive is responsible for managing day-to-day HR operations, recruitment, employee relations, attendance and payroll coordination, onboarding, statutory compliance, and employee engagement to ensure smooth functioning of the dealership.

Key Responsibilities

* Recruitment and Selection: Handle recruitment for sales executives, service advisors, technicians, customer relationship executives, and administrative staff.
* Onboarding and Induction: Manage joining formalities, document verification, appointment letters, and employee induction.
* Attendance and Leave Management: Maintain attendance records, shift schedules, leave records, and overtime details.
* Payroll Coordination: Coordinate monthly payroll processing, salary inputs, incentives, deductions, and employee reimbursement details.
* Employee Relations: Address employee grievances, support disciplinary procedures, and maintain a positive working environment.
* HR Documentation: Maintain employee files, HR databases, employment records, and letters related to appointment, confirmation, transfer, and resignation.
* Statutory Compliance: Support applicable labour law compliance, including EPF, ESI, professional tax where applicable, and other statutory records.
* Performance Management: Coordinate performance appraisals, probation reviews, and employee performance tracking.
* Training and Development: Organize training programmes for dealership employees, including sales staff, service personnel, and customer service teams.
* Employee Engagement: Conduct employee engagement activities, welfare initiatives, and retention programmes.
* Exit Formalities: Handle resignation documentation, exit interviews, full-and-final settlement coordination, and relieving letters.
* Management Reporting: Prepare monthly HR reports covering headcount, absenteeism, attrition, recruitment, and employee performance.

Eligibility Criteria

* MBA in Human Resources or an equivalent postgraduate qualification.
* Around 2 years of experience in HR operations, preferably in an automobile dealership or related industry.
* Knowledge of recruitment, payroll coordination, attendance management, and HR documentation.
* Basic understanding of applicable labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Good communication, interpersonal, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office, and HRMS software.

Key Skills Required

* Recruitment and talent acquisition
* Payroll and attendance management
* Employee engagement and grievance handling
* HR policies and statutory compliance
* HR reporting and documentation
* Communication and coordination
* MS Excel and HR software

Pay: From ₹18,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

  

**Job Overview**
----------------

Role summary

The Senior Business Systems Analyst carries the analytical execution load of the program. The role works through the detail of the existing learning estate, prepares the analysis that supports rationalisation decisions, and executes the mapping, cleanup and validation activity that follows those decisions. This is a hands-on seat and the volume of detailed work sits here.

Key responsibilities

* Build and maintain the inventory of curricula, learning items, assignments and associated attributes for assigned functional areas.
* Perform detailed analysis to surface duplicates, outdated content, incomplete records, inactive items, dummy entries and administrative accounts.
* Prepare structured analysis packs that allow stakeholders to make migrate, consolidate, archive or retire decisions efficiently.
* Execute data mapping activity between source and target structures, working to the standards agreed for the program.
* Perform and evidence data cleanup and remediation activity ahead of migration.
* Support reconciliation, test execution and user acceptance testing, and capture the associated evidence.
* Maintain trackers, logs, templates and checklists to the standard set by the Lead BSA.
* Prepare recurring status, progress and exception reporting for the assigned functional area.
* Raise data quality concerns, anomalies and emerging risks promptly through the agreed channel.

Required experience

* 8+ years of business analysis, data analysis or systems analysis experience, including involvement in a system transition or data migration.
* Strong practical data-handling capability — comfortable working at volume with spreadsheets, extracts, structured queries and reporting output.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently through detailed, high-volume analytical work with accuracy and consistency.
* Experience preparing documentation, trackers and templates to a standard suitable for a regulated environment.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, and comfort operating with stakeholders in a different time zone.
* Willingness to work a dedicated shift pattern providing overlap with US Eastern business hours.
* Experience working within GxP-regulated environments.

Preferred experience

* Exposure to a learning management system, enterprise HR platform or comparable enterprise application.
* Experience in a regulated industry, ideally life sciences or pharmaceutical.
* Experience supporting testing and validation cycles.

Ways of working

* Works to the direction and priorities set by the assigned Client workstream lead or program owner.
* Maintains transparent, timely status against assigned activities and escalates blockers early rather than at the point of impact.
* Documents decisions, actions and open items so that context is held in the program record and not solely with the individual.
* Cross-trains across adjacent functional areas to provide coverage redundancy within the Milestone team.

Compliance and environment

* Works entirely within Client's systems, tools and environments. No client data is moved to, stored in or processed on external tooling without Client's express written approval.
* Operates within a GxP-regulated environment and follows Client's data privacy, data integrity, information security and records-retention standards at all times.
* Completes all Client-mandated onboarding, access provisioning and compliance training before commencing project activity.

Participates in Milestone's structured program induction covering program context, stakeholder map, ways of working and tooling

title: COO - Club Oxygen
description:

We are looking for an experienced and dynamic **Head of Hospitality** to lead and oversee the Group's hospitality business with complete responsibility for **business performance, operations, profitability, people, customer experience, expansion, and strategic growth**.

The ideal candidate should have strong **CEO / COO / Business Head / General Management experience**, with the ability to manage complex operations, build high\-performing teams, improve business performance, and drive sustainable growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide overall strategic and operational leadership for the hospitality division.
* Take ownership of **revenue, profitability, cost control, service quality, and business growth**.
* Develop and execute short\-term and long\-term business strategies.
* Oversee hospitality properties, restaurants, resorts, and related operations.
* Establish systems, processes, SOPs, and performance standards across operations.
* Identify opportunities for **business expansion, new properties, new concepts, and strategic partnerships**.
* Monitor financial performance, budgets, cash flows, margins, and operational costs.
* Build, develop, and retain strong leadership teams across functions.

* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory, regulatory, safety, and operational requirements.

* Proven experience managing large teams and multi\-unit / multi\-location operations.

* Ability to operate at both **strategic and execution levels**.
